name: probe8
purpose: Small subset for quick traced experiments. Too few tasks for significance claims; use it for timings, traces and failure modes.
source: Drawn from the 30 tuning tasks not used by E02. No held-out task is included.
method: Repo quota 4 fastapi, 3 rich, 1 requests. Exhaustive search for the subset whose patch size, hunk count and problem-statement length quantiles, and whose multi-file, pre-cutoff and multi-test-file shares, are closest to all 129 dev tasks.
